title: Philippine Migrant Worker Data Likely Leaked in 69GB Government Breach
summary: An unknown operator appears to have exfiltrated SQL Server backups from the Philippine Overseas Employment Administration in under a half hour.

title: mSecure Warns Users to Change Passwords, Reset 2FA and Passkeys After Suspicious Activity
summary: Customers of the mSecure password manager are being urged to act now to protect the confidential information they store in it, possibly by changing passwords, resetting two-factor authentication (2FA), and removing passkeys.

email_summary: Customers of the mSecure password manager are being urged to act now to protect the confidential information they store in it, possibly by changing passwords, resetting two-factor authentication (2FA), and removing passkeys. The warning came in an email sent on November 3 in the name of developer mSeven Software.
